areas.name: North Canopy
areas.description: Tall evergreen forest with a closed canopy — the healthiest part of the region.

areas.name: West Woodland
areas.description: A forest fragment cut off by an old plantation edge and a road.

areas.name: Central Clearing
areas.description: Cleared and degraded land where a corridor could be restored.

areas.name: East Woodland
areas.description: A second fragment with old hornbill nest trees and fruiting figs.

areas.name: South Shola Meadow
areas.description: Montane shola grassland and rocky cliffs at the forest edge.

areas.name: River Edge
areas.description: Streamside forest where frogs breed and monsoon run-off erodes bare ground.

amendments.title: Living Charter Amendment 1 — Connectivity
amendments.question: How should a wildlife route be judged for the rest of this region?

option_a.name: Continuous Corridors
option_a.summary: A route only counts when every step is connected habitat.
effects: Unlocks Canopy Bridges: a rope bridge across a road (2 capacity) that canopy animals can use.

option_b.name: Stepping-Stone Networks
option_b.summary: A route may hop one gap beside a planted stepping-stone grove.
effects: Unlocks Stepping-Stone Groves on open ground (2 capacity).
A route may hop a single open, degraded, grassland or road cell when it starts or lands on a grove.
Streams and cliffs can never be hopped.

amendments.title: Living Charter Amendment 2 — Recovery
amendments.question: How should degraded forest recover for the rest of this region?

option_a.name: Natural Succession
option_a.summary: Damaged forest regrows by itself when healthy forest surrounds it.
effects: At the end of each round, degraded forest with 3 or more healthy forest neighbours regrows for free.
A dry spell stops regrowth for that round; Lantana-hit cells cannot regrow the same round.

option_b.name: Active Restoration
option_b.summary: No regrowth by itself — but every restoration heals a whole cluster at once.
effects: Restoring costs 2 and also heals every degraded cell directly beside the target.
Results appear immediately, before the round ends.
